topic.title: Questions About Pretrained Molecular Generators
topic.forumName: Enveda CASMI 2026 - Molecule ID From Mass Spectra
topic.content:
I have a few questions about pretrained molecular generation models:

  1. FRIGID: Has anyone found the official NGBoost token-length predictor and its feature file? They seem to be missing from the public release.

  2. Formula consistency:Has anyone found a reliable way to make formula-conditioned generators produce molecules that exactly match the requested formula?

  3. Alternative models:Does anyone know other pretrained MS/MS-to-structure generators with publicly available weights and reproducible training data (without restricted NIST data)?

Any references or suggestions would be appreciated. Thanks
